summary: This bill reduces the number of pay steps and shortens the time between pay grade advancements for officers and members of the U.S. Park Police by amending the District of Columbia Police and Firemen’s Salary Act of 1958.

scores.thoughts: This bill proposes to condense the pay grade steps for U.S. Park Police officers, which would likely result in officers reaching higher pay steps more quickly. This acceleration in pay progression would lead to increased government expenditure on salaries for the U.S. Park Police.
